name: Generate 66 cylinders / 3828 HR
Modbus TCP Server (Unit ID 1)
HR 0-3827 | 66 x 58 registers | FC03 max 125 per request
info: Install node-red-contrib-modbus. Server listens on TCP port 1502 by default. Change serverPort to 502 if required and permitted by OS/container. Each cylinder has 58 registers. Data is high WORD first. STRING[48] is treated as 48 data bytes per the supplied table.
